title: A Battery for AI Propensity Measurement: Rubrics, Synthetic Item Banks, and Annotations
abstract: arXiv:2610.34614v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We release a battery of 28 propensities for AI research, with expert-written rubrics, synthetic datasets, and annotated demand intervals, built with the method of Romero-Alvarado et al. (2026). We selected a wide collection of generic propensities that may influence the behavior of AI systems and humans. They are inspired by psychometric, psychological, and behavioral research, so that experimental results can be understood in the context of familiar constructs previously used also for human behavior research. The rubrics are useful for annotating existing benchmarks whose items may be relevant or not for one or more propensities. For easier profiling, however, the synthetic datasets are defined in such a way that they should be sensitive to one propensity only, allowing for a quick prototyping of propensity profiles using the battery of datasets. We also outline directions for future propensity research.

translated_title: 一套AI倾向测量工具集：评分标准、合成题库与标注
translated_abstract: 我们发布了面向AI研究的包含28种倾向的测试工具集，其中包括专家撰写的评分标准、合成数据集以及标注的需求区间，该工具集采用Romero-Alvarado等人（2026）的方法构建。我们选取了可能影响AI系统和人类行为的广泛的通用倾向集合。这些倾向受心理测量学、心理学和行为学研究的启发，因此实验结果可以在熟悉的构念背景下加以理解，而这些构念此前也曾用于人类行为研究。这些评分标准可用于标注现有基准测试，以判断其题目是否与一种或多种倾向相关。为了便于画像分析，合成数据集被定义为仅对单一倾向敏感，从而可以利用该数据集工具集快速构建倾向画像的原型。我们还概述了未来倾向研究的方向。
tldr: 该论文发布了一套包含28种AI倾向的测量工具集，配有专家评分标准、仅对单一倾向敏感的合成数据集及相关标注，可快速构建AI系统的行为倾向画像。
en_tdlr: This paper releases a battery of 28 AI propensities with expert-written rubrics, single-propensity-sensitive synthetic datasets, and annotations, enabling quick profiling of AI systems' behavioral tendencies.
